messages:
elaine_cs: Weekly account health check for NovaHealth — focusing on caching + batching metrics from the last 7d. Posting current snapshot below; please call out questions or regressions. @sophie_eng @raj_infra @mike_cs

mike_cs: cool, paste the numbers?

elaine_cs: Summary: Usage 3.2M tokens/day (-4% w/w). p50 latency 110ms, p95 480ms (+12ms). Error rate 0.8% (-0.1%). Spend $12.4k (+2%).
Caching/batching: KV hit rate 62% (was 55%), Prefix hit 40%. Avg batch size 4.1 (target 4–6). Cost per 1k tokens $1.25 (was $1.60).

sophie_eng: Nice on cost — looks like batching + cache helped. Hit rate still below our 70% target. Any recent changes?

raj_infra: We enabled `prefix_cache=true` on novahealth canary last Wed and ran a prefill job (~120k prefixes). Expect hit rate bump from that. Also rolled 8-bit quant for that model which reduced compute cost.

elaine_cs: Customer: onboarding flows spike (lots of unique prefixes) which increases cold-miss tail. They want a plan to smooth search endpoint latency for new users.

sophie_eng: Recommendation: increase `max_batch_size` for search route to 8, set `target_latency_ms: 150`, and bump KV TTL to 2h to keep prefixes warm. Add adaptive batching (min wait) to avoid hurting single-user p50.

elaine_cs: Config snippet suggestion:
```yaml
routes:
  - name: search
    batching:
      max_batch_size: 8
      min_batch_ms: 20
      target_latency_ms: 150
    cache:
      prefix_cache: true
      kv_ttl_secs: 7200
```

mike_cs: What are the tradeoffs for increasing batch size? Product team worried about single-user latency for interactive flows.

sophie_eng: Tradeoffs: slight p50 increase when traffic low, but much better throughput and lower cost at scale. Adaptive batching with `min_batch_ms: 20` mitigates single-user impact. We'll monitor p50 and p95.

raj_infra: I'll schedule a canary for that config on dedicated-3 and run a cache prefill job at 01:00 UTC. Prefill workload = top 200k prefixes from logs.

deploy-bot: deploy started: config-canary/novahealth/cache-batching -> dedicated-3

deploy-bot: deploy succeeded: canary healthy after 3m, routing 5%

elaine_cs: Action items:
- raj_infra: run 24h canary + prefill (cron job)
- sophie_eng: add dashboards & alerts for p95, hit_rate, avg_batch, cost_per_1k
- mike_cs: draft a short customer note explaining what we're changing and expected impact on latency & cost (include rollback plan)
ETA: EoW.

mike_cs: :thumbsup: will draft. Quick back-of-envelope: with hit_rate +7pt and avg batch from ~4 to ~6 we estimate ~18% reduction in token cost -> roughly $~2.2k/mo savings at current volume. I'll include that calc.

sophie_eng: I'll add dashboard tiles: `hit_rate`, `avg_batch_size`, `cost_per_1k_tokens`, `p95_latency`. Query examples for metrics team: `sum(tokens)/1000 as k_tokens`, `pctile(latency,95)` and `sum(cost)/sum(k_tokens)` for cost_per_1k.

elaine_cs: Thanks all — ping here if canary shows any regression. I'll update NovaHealth success plan after the canary. :rocket:

billing-bot: Note: estimated monthly spend after changes (provisional): $10.2k — update after 48h canary.
